title: Kafka Broker Configuration
description: Listener addressing, security, and broker settings for the single-node broker.

listener.title: Internal Listener
listener.description: The always-on listener other workloads in the cluster connect to.

port.title: Port
port.description: Client listener port. Keep in sync with the service port under System Settings.

advertised_host.title: Advertised Host
advertised_host.description: Address advertised to in-cluster clients. Empty uses the workload name, which is the service DNS name and the right answer for in-cluster clients.

external.title: External Access
external.description: Optional second listener for clients outside the cluster. Needs a host-type port under System Settings; set both fields or neither. The advertised host is the node address, which you can find under Cluster -> Services once the host port is deployed.

port.title: External Port
port.description: Port for clients outside the cluster. Must match the host port declared under System Settings.

advertised_host.title: External Advertised Host
advertised_host.description: Node address external clients can reach. Find it under Cluster -> Services after the host port is deployed.

security.title: Security
security.description: Authentication and encryption applied to every client listener. SSL and SASL_SSL encrypt the connection but do not require a client certificate; the broker accepts any client unless you also set extra_properties: {"ssl.client.auth": "required"} for mTLS.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: PEM content, wired to secrets on deployment. All three are required. TLS encrypts the connection; it does not authenticate the client. Client certificates are not required by default; add extra_properties: {"ssl.client.auth": "required"} for mTLS.

ca_crt.title: CA Certificate
ca_crt.description: CA certificate that signed the server certificate (PEM).

tls_key.title: Server Private Key
tls_key.description: Broker private key in PKCS#8 PEM format (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----).

sasl.title: SASL Authentication
sasl.description: SASL/PLAIN credentials the broker accepts. Wire both to secrets.

username.title: Username
username.description: The single username clients authenticate with. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '@' and '-' only: it is used verbatim as a JAAS option name in the broker's login configuration. Either a secret reference or a literal limited to letters, digits, dot, underscore, @ and hyphen — it is also used unquoted as the JAAS user_<name> option, so other characters would corrupt the broker config.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for that username. It goes into a quoted JAAS string, so it cannot contain a double quote, a backslash or a newline.

jvm.title: JVM
jvm.description: Java runtime sizing for the broker process.

heap_opts.title: Heap Options
heap_opts.description: JVM heap flags. Size the workload memory limit above the heap; 1 GB is a comfortable floor.

extra_properties.title: Extra Broker Properties
extra_properties.description: Any server.properties entry this app does not wrap, applied verbatim (e.g. log.retention.hours = 48). Managed settings win on conflict; do not set log.dirs, it is pinned to the persistent volume. Names take letters, digits, '.' and '_'; values are single-line strings.
